weaknesses.title: Empty-string ENSUREBAGLINE appends blank line (NEW=1)
weaknesses.detail: ENSUREBAGLINE allow "" is treated as a real membership add. Agents with blank HOST/ENV can pollute allowlists with empty bag lines that LINESF counts.
weaknesses.repro: ENSUREBAGLINE a allow "" → NEW=1 N increases

weaknesses.title: Flag is ENSUREBAGLINE_NEW not _HIT
weaknesses.detail: Agents reading ENSUREBAGLINE_HIT (pattern from DROP/CUTF) get 0 always. Must use _NEW for append-vs-exists. Easy false soft logic.

weaknesses.title: DUMPOBJ multiline allow still plate-unsafe
weaknesses.detail: Same class as roster/queue boards — dump/aN.bag side files required for rehydrate.
weaknesses.repro: LOOKUP allow after DUMPOBJ truncates at first NL

weaknesses.title: INCF local counter fails — need LET n = n + 1
weaknesses.detail: INCF c errors with INCF field when c is a LET var. Field INCF only. Walk loops verbose.
weaknesses.repro: LET c=0; INCF c → err INCF field

weaknesses.title: Exact membership only (no DNS suffix match)
weaknesses.detail: ensure api does not satisfy has api.prod; prefix walk needs EACH+STARTS. No ENSUREBAGLINE SUFFIX mode.

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE=abc softens
weaknesses.detail: Non-numeric REQUIRE miss exit 0 on gate deny.
